01 / THE PROBLEM
01 / THE PROBLEM

E-waste disappears into a black box.

Collection, recycling and customer settlement are often treated as one event. They are not.

01

Disconnected handoffs

A household, partner, hub and recycler each see only part of the journey.

02

Unverified quantities

Image estimates, physical scale weight and recycler gate weight are easily confused.

03

Missing customer closure

Customers need a transparent offer, statement and auditable outcome.

INT 252 · Saiyam Kapur · LPU02 / 20
Explain the problem without inventing national e-waste statistics. The project addresses traceability, physical verification and transparent customer communication. Do not claim an operational nationwide collection service.

04 / REACT FULL-STACK ARCHITECTURE
04 / REACT FULL-STACK ARCHITECTURE

Designed for real workflows.

React 19 + Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM.

01React UI: dashboards, image scanner, charts and Tara
02Next.js routes: validation, sessions and role policies

12 / FIELD OPERATIONS
12 / FIELD OPERATIONS

Physical evidence at the edge.

A collection partner weighs items; a center manager verifies them before dispatch.

INT 252 · Saiyam Kapur · LPU13 / 20
Each role performs a different action. The partner records actual collected quantity and scale weight. The center manager verifies the collection and creates an outbound batch. Server-side permissions prevent one role from silently skipping a step.
◈ EcoTrace India

13 / RECYCLER OPERATIONS

01Batch receipt logged independently
02>10% weight variance triggers human review
03Documented mass cannot exceed received mass
04Recycler log and processed quantity are saved

16 / TRUST & PRIVACY
16 / TRUST & PRIVACY

Honesty is an engineering decision.

Trust is enforced by the data model, API and interface—not only by marketing copy.

01

ROLE-BASED ACCESS

Server checks each protected operation.

02

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

Home addresses and bills are owner-scoped.

03

MASS-BALANCE RULES

Estimates, scale weights and recovery differ.

04

NO FALSE CLAIMS

Sample centers and wallet entries are labeled.

INT 252 · Saiyam Kapur · LPU17 / 20
Passwords are hashed with bcrypt and session tokens are hashed before PostgreSQL storage. The public trace lookup redacts private addresses. Sample center entries are not government approvals. Internal EPR tracking does not issue legal credits.
